why.title: Travel planning that respects your time

local.title: Local focus
local.text: Every trek, stay and tour is in Nepal, described with the details that matter on the ground.

pricing.title: Clear pricing
pricing.text: The total is calculated by our server from the listed price, so what you see is what you book.

flexible.title: Flexible plans
flexible.text: Cancel any upcoming booking from your dashboard before the travel date.

bilingual.title: Nepali and English
bilingual.text: Switch languages at any time. Your choice is remembered on this device.

seasons.title: Pick your season
seasons.text: Spring and autumn usually bring the clearest mountain views. The monsoon brings green valleys and cloudier peaks.

altitude.title: Go slowly at altitude
altitude.text: Above about 3,000 m, rest days help your body adjust. Shorter routes are a good start if you are new to trekking.

culture.title: Travel with respect
culture.text: Walk clockwise around stupas, ask before photographing people and dress modestly at temples.

newsletter.title: Trail notes in your inbox
newsletter.text: Occasional updates on new routes, stays and seasonal tips. No spam.
